_comment: THE default model for every role in the toolset — one exact id each, read by the CLI (cli/lib/model-defaults.js), the harness (mt_eval_harness/model_defaults.py), forge, the MCP server (through the CLI) and the docent edge function. Never hand-edit a default anywhere else. A default is an exact id, never an alias or a floating '-latest' name: a run must say which model translated, and the translation cache is keyed by model, so a default that moved by itself would re-bill everything. `rule` is how `champollion models check` reads the provider's live list: the newest id matching `match` (named group `v` = version, compared numerically; `date` = a dated snapshot, newest wins) is the candidate. check fails when a pinned id is no longer listed, and names the rule's current candidate when it differs; `node cli/scripts/check-model-defaults.mjs --update` writes the candidates here, as a reviewed change. `checked` is the date the id was last confirmed live.

translate.describe: The CLI's default translation model (method llm, through OpenRouter).

openai.describe: The openai method's default (OpenAI's own API name: a dated snapshot).

gemini.describe: The gemini method's default (Google's own API name).

anthropic.describe: The anthropic method's default (Anthropic's own API name).

harness.describe: mt-eval's default model for a run with no -m.

docent.describe: champollion.dev's site docent (the docent-chat edge function), through OpenRouter with data collection denied (founder, 2026-10-07: run it on Luna).
